title: BRAKE LATE (KEEP ON TRUCKING)
style: Style: Acoustic rock anthem, driving drums
lyrics:
[Intro — engine hum → guitar riff]

Start it up…

[Verse 1]

He’d laugh loud, drive fast
Never living in the past

[Verse 2]

Boots on dirt, hands on wheel
Teaching her what hope can feel

[Pre-Chorus]

Hear his voice in every mile

[Chorus]

Go fast, brake late
Don’t you wait
Keep on trucking, don’t slow down
Carry love from town to town

[Bridge — Hindi-style bass chant]

Om… Hum…
Spirit strong, carry on

[Final Chorus — choir harmonies]
[Outro — crowd chant]

Keep on trucking… fade…
